title: Your conductor is running and you can push; the keys are blocked by one setting
headline: Your first agent is live: conductor@web-summit.jose started from your kit and pushed its first commit to dev from your account, which proves your push access and puts you at L3 on the leaderboard. Agent keys (L4) are blocked because this session's network policy refuses pki.sgit.ai, where the key tool lives. Two minutes in the environment settings fixes it. Three things need you, best before the 13:00 stand-up.

stats.label: your level, computed by the site (was L1)

for_you.ask: Allow pki.sgit.ai in your Claude environment
for_you.detail: Every agent makes its key with pki-agent.mjs, downloaded from pki.sgit.ai. This session's network policy refused that host at 00:34 UTC, so no agent of yours can make a key, and L4 needs keys. It is on the 13:00 agenda.
options: add pki.sgit.ai under Allowed domains (cloud environment menu in the session title bar, Edit, Network access), keeping package managers ticked
ask Dinis for a copy of the tool in the repository instead
for_you.recommend: Allow the host now; then tell me and I make my key at once.

for_you.ask: Start your dashboard agent (and your dev agent)
for_you.detail: Both prompts are ready in people/jose/kit/README.md: open a new session, paste the prompt, let it run once. The dashboard agent is the other half of L4.
options: dashboard agent today, dev agent today too
dashboard agent today, dev agent after the stand-up
for_you.recommend: Both today, after you allow pki.sgit.ai, so each makes its key on its first run.

for_you.detail: Create a scheduled task that fires into this same session at 07:20, 12:20 and 17:20 UTC (cron 20 7,12,17 * * *), with the scheduled-task prompt in the kit. That is the L5 step for the conductor.
for_you.recommend: Yes, at those times: each run lands before a stand-up.
